description: This Java class implements a generic cache for Comparable values, providing methods to retrieve and update entries only when a new value is greater than the current one. The cache uses Caffeine as the underlying caching library and supports size limits and optional cache naming for metrics.

classes.name: ComparableCache
classes.description: A thread-safe cache for Comparable values that updates entries only if the new value is greater than the existing one. It allows size limiting and optional cache naming.

methods.name: ComparableCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a specified maximum size and optional cache name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key, returning null if absent.

methods.name: updateIfNewOrGreater
methods.description: Updates the cache entry for a key only if the new value is greater than the current one or if the key does not exist. Returns true if an update occurred.
